gtc.text: Kal is a Gruul shaman sent by Nikya of the Old Ways to watch the Izzet from an abandoned Orzhov spire and make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory.

When Durri tells him that a Selesnyan healer's camp was massacred, reportedly by the Rakdos, Kal secretly tracks the war party on foot to protect her, and Janik catches him and nearly skewers him before the battle begins.

A Rakdos flailer hooks Kal and drags him across the ground, but Kal channels what he learned from the Izzet into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates the flailer, the demons and the remaining Rakdos.
Nikya reveals that Massacre Girl escaped but Kal killed a bloodwitch, and Kal credits his new spell to watching the Izzet, though Durri calls it Gruul.
